scope: Observed-data diagnostic comparison only; no runtime selection or qualification claim
region: All voxels above 0.5 in the predeclared target brain mask; target grid and mask identities fixed across checkpoints, separately in each direction
grid: Original prepared target image lattice; exported checkpoint map must have identical shape and affine within 1e-9 mm coefficient tolerance
window: Axis-aligned box with radius 3 mm, radius ceil(3/spacing) voxels per axis; uniform moments with constant-zero image extension
score: Mean over every declared target voxel of 1 - clamp(covariance / sqrt(var_fixed * var_warped + epsilon), -1, 1)^2
epsilon: (1e-4 * variance of the fixed target image within the declared mask)^2; independent of checkpoint and warped image
invalid_window: Any invalid map sample, out-of-image source coordinate or nonfinite warped value in the local window gives loss 1 and signed correlation -1. Denominator never shrinks.
aggregation: Report each direction and their equal-weight mean; report fixed count, center/window coverage, nonfinite counts, signed correlation and exact input hashes
undefined: Nonfinite/zero target variance or nonfinite numerical moments are explicit audit failures, never silently removed cases
annotation_use: No anatomical labels or moving-dependent masks enter this score or its region; anatomical scoring remains a separate evaluation
